about: Request of esv::itemwall::WallSystem (bg3.exe+0x3379B60) to summon one item of a wall: one per eoc::itemwall::ItemSpawn of the wall's CreateComponent when its animation slot comes up; consumed by esv::summon::SpawnSystem (Toolkit ProcessCreateSummon). Saved: model game.itemwall.v0.RequestSummonOneFrameComponent (120 bytes) with members m_Owner, m_Template, m_Position, m_Rotation, m_Level, m_SpellUsed, m_SpellCastUuid, m_Lifetime, m_Status (same order in the component). Never seen alive. Registry total 136 (server row; not flagged one-frame).

evidence.says: Savegame model member 0 (m_Owner). Load bg3.exe+0x25B3480 line 197: qword +0 = resolved entity. WallSystem line 598 writes CreateComponent.Owner as the request's first 8-byte value (+0).
Model member 1 (m_Template). Load: FixedString at +8. WallSystem lines 635-646: +8 = ItemSpawn+0 (FixedString).
Model member 2 (m_Position). Load: qword +0xC, dword +0x14. WallSystem: +0xC (8 bytes) and +0x14 = ItemSpawn+4..+0xF.
Model member 3 (m_Rotation). Load: qwords +0x18/+0x20. WallSystem: dwords +0x18..+0x24 = ItemSpawn+0x10..+0x1F.
Model member 4 (m_Level). Load: FixedString at +0x28. WallSystem lines 622-633: +0x28 = CreateComponent+0x2C (Level).

Model member 5 (m_SpellUsed). Load: FixedString +0x30, qwords +0x38..+0x58, FixedString +0x60. WallSystem line 601: bg3.exe+0x7A2480 called with req+0x30 and CreateComponent+0x30 (SpellId copy), Prototype +0x60 = CreateComponent+0x60.
Model member 6 (m_SpellCastUuid). Load: qwords +0x68/+0x70. WallSystem lines 615-621: dwords +0x68..+0x74 = CreateComponent+0x68..+0x77.
Model member 7 (m_Lifetime, ls::model::game::summons::v1::Lifetime). Load: qword +0x78. WallSystem line 599 writes the (float, index) qword as the request's sixteenth 8-byte value (+0x78).
Model member 8 (m_Status). Load: FixedString at +0x80. WallSystem: +0x80 = FixedString returned by vtable+0x38 of the item-wall data interface.

fields.name: Value
fields.evidence: Same shape as eoc::summon::LifetimeComponent's std::variant<uint8_t, float> (Components/Data.h). WallSystem bg3.exe+0x3379B60 lines 556-562: takes the value returned by virtual slot +0x20; when it is greater than 0 the value goes in the low 4 bytes and 1 in the high 4 bytes, otherwise the whole is 0; stored as one qword at +0x78.
